correctness.rationale: By meet adjunction, a nonempty old A has residual complement(A) union B for old B not containing A, and T when the target is above A. For a chain antecedent t_i the residual is the target below t_i and is T otherwise, with negation bottom. These cases give all materializers, including the bottom/top collision. Inclusion of the old materializers reverses inclusion of their excluded principal filters; the chain materializers are strictly ordered above them. Their sizes are N, b+1−2^(n−r), and b+i respectively, giving the polynomial. The three disjoint failure classes contribute 3^n−2^n, (b−1)(k−1), and binom(k,2). For k=o(b), the numerator divided by b² is (3/4)^n+k/b+O(1/b+(k/b)^2), and the error is little-o of the sum. Normalizing by b² for finite k/b and by k² when k/b diverges gives both satisfaction limits. The frozen verifier tests only 25 finite pairs (recorded 8,955 input pairs); it was inspected, not run. The argument applies for all n,k≥1.
